source.note: Structural decomposition of the article text supplied in the working conversation; quantitative anecdotes and forecasts are not independently validated by this record.

kernel.statement: Cheap, replicable machine cognition can change the scarcity regime of knowledge work, causing bottlenecks to migrate into context, verification, coordination, judgment, and governance and making structural redesign possible.

nodes.name: CognitiveSubstrate
nodes.responsibility: Provide replicable and parallelizable machine cognition.

nodes.name: ScarcityInversion
nodes.responsibility: Model bottleneck migration after cognition becomes less scarce.

nodes.name: StateContextFabric
nodes.responsibility: Expose task-relevant organizational state to machine actors.

nodes.name: VerificationOracle
nodes.responsibility: Determine whether produced work is correct, sufficient, safe, or complete.

nodes.name: AutonomyHorizon
nodes.responsibility: Represent how long useful work can proceed without human intervention.

nodes.name: CognitiveOrchestration
nodes.responsibility: Allow a human or controller to direct multiple concurrent cognitive workers.

nodes.name: HumanControlTopology
nodes.responsibility: Place human authority at action, supervision, policy, exception, or fully external positions as task consequence requires.

nodes.name: CoordinationCompression
nodes.responsibility: Route and compress information as actor count and interaction density grow.

nodes.name: AINativeRedesign
nodes.responsibility: Redesign workflow topology around machine cognition rather than bolt AI onto inherited human workflows.

nodes.name: OrganizationalObservability
nodes.responsibility: Make large human-machine organizations traceable, auditable, observable, and recoverable without requiring full human legibility.

nodes.name: CoordinatedScale
nodes.responsibility: Scale agent capacity without losing useful throughput to coordination, verification, or state inconsistency.

nodes.name: EmergentOrganizationalForm
nodes.responsibility: Represent new organization/economic forms enabled by the changed substrate and coordination regime.

nodes.name: Reliability
nodes.responsibility: Bound, detect, contain, retry, and recover from accumulated failures.

nodes.name: Security
nodes.responsibility: Protect identities, instructions, credentials, tools, state, and external effects.

nodes.name: PermissionAuthority
nodes.responsibility: Separate technical capability from authorization and delegation.

nodes.name: Recovery
nodes.responsibility: Resume or compensate long-horizon work after execution, semantic, or external uncertainty.

nodes.name: IncentivesObjectiveAlignment
nodes.responsibility: Keep local optimizers aligned with real outcomes and expose Goodhart failure.

nodes.name: Economics
nodes.responsibility: Account for compute, latency, verification, review, infrastructure, and failure cost.

nodes.name: Governance
nodes.responsibility: Own goals, policy, accountability, risk acceptance, and irreversible decision authority.

nodes.name: LearningEvolution
nodes.responsibility: Improve compositions and methods from operating evidence while preserving verification and rollback.

laws.name: ScarcityMigration
laws.statement: When a resource becomes abundant, bottlenecks migrate rather than disappear.

laws.name: AutonomyCeiling
laws.statement: Useful autonomy is bounded by the weakest required system property.
laws.conceptualForm: A_max ~ min(capability, context, verification, permission, recovery)

laws.name: RedesignMultiplier
laws.statement: The realized value of a new substrate depends strongly on surrounding system redesign.

falsificationQuestions: Are there domains where model capability rises substantially but context or verification do not become the next bottlenecks?
Does adding autonomous agents increase coordination cost faster than useful throughput?
At what task classes does human-on-the-loop supervision fail because review is delayed or too weak?
Does verification cost dominate generation savings in non-code knowledge work?
Do security and permission constraints cap autonomy before context or verification?
Does greater autonomy increase correlated failure modes?
Which productivity claims survive outcome-level measurement rather than task-completion counting?
promotionRule: No candidate becomes shared-core truth from this case alone; require repeated cross-domain evidence.
